should_handle.instructions: Should the coding-agent cluster handle or respond to this message?

criteria.true: Message asks for work, answers, status, or provides task context
criteria.false: Unrelated human smalltalk or noise to ignore

target_role.instructions: Which role in the cluster should handle this message?

reply_to_msg.instructions: Which recent message ID is this message continuing or replying to?

delivery_kind.instructions: Should this inbound IM message be delivered to the agent as a stateless conversational 'note' (default for Q&A, chat, status checks, and quick instructions) or as a tracked 'task' (for multi-step engineering/research work, handoff chains, or continuing an active task thread)?

criteria.note: Direct 1-on-1 or group chat Q&A, greetings, status checks, or conversational turns that do not require opening a tracked task slot
criteria.task: Substantive multi-step work request, cross-role handoff workflow, or continuation of an active task chain

templates.ignore_rubric: Human chatter not directed at any agent

contradicts_done.instructions: Does this completion report state that the work is actually unfinished, blocked on external input, or failed with an unresolved error?

criteria.true: States the task could not be finished, is blocked, or failed

actual_status.instructions: What is the true status described by this report?

criteria.blocked: Blocked waiting on user, permission, or external dependency
criteria.failed: Failed due to an unrecoverable error

reason.instructions: Why did the agent end its turn without calling onlyne_complete?

criteria.forgot_complete: Finished the work and summarized it without calling onlyne_complete
criteria.blocked: Waiting on external input or blocker

templates.forgot_complete: If your work is finished, call onlyne_complete with outcome="done" now.
templates.blocked: If you are blocked on an external dependency, call onlyne_complete with outcome="blocked" now.
templates.error: If the task cannot succeed due to an error, call onlyne_complete with outcome="failed" now.

is_thrashing.instructions: Is the agent stuck in a repetitive error loop repeating the same failing action?

progress.instructions: How well is the session progressing?

phase.instructions: Which activity phase is the agent currently in?

action.instructions: What recovery action does this fault call for?

criteria.retry: Transient network error, rate limit (429), lock contention, or temporary blip
criteria.recycle: Session process is stuck, looping, or unresponsive and needs a fresh session slot
criteria.fail: Unrecoverable configuration, permission, or deterministic failure
criteria.escalate: Ambiguous state or requirement question that requires human operator judgment
